description: Executes an APIDL (Tuval Design Language) script in a closed-loop iterative design convergence pipeline. Executes chained canvas commands, captures a high-resolution screenshot and layer coordinate tree, audits layout collisions, and enforces design quality standards across iterative phases ("draft" -> "refine" -> "final").

phase.description: Current loop phase: "draft" (initial structural generation), "refine" (fine-tuning coordinates, typography hierarchy, margins, or balance after visual review), or "final" (ready to seal design; triggers automated Quality Gate audit).

rationale.description: Design rationale explaining design system choices (Golden Ratio proportions, modular typography scale, color palette harmony, client style preset).

script.description: Multi-line APIDL script containing commands such as canvas_set_size, canvas_set_background, canvas_set_gradient, shape_add, svg_add, text_add, layer_transform, text_update_style, layer_align, etc.

stylePreset.description: The target visual aesthetic preset matching client requirements.

name: studio_execute_apidl
